description: An accessible and encrypted personal diary integrated with NVDA. It combines dated entries, password protection and optional recovery, real-time spell checking, and encrypted ZIP backup export and merge import.
changelog: Added encrypted backup export and import to the unlocked Diary window. Export creates a ZIP containing diario.enc and diario.backup.enc. Import validates the ZIP and merges only entries whose identifiers are not already present, without replacing existing entries. Backups from the same vault require no additional password; backups from independent vaults request their own password. Updated interface translations, documentation and tests in all five supported languages. The encrypted vault format remains compatible with version 1.1.0.
